caption: The drawing is composed of three horizontally aligned rectangular sections, each filled with various white line illustrations against a dark textured background. Across all three sections, there are repeated depictions of animals resembling goats or dogs, each drawn in a stylized, simplistic manner. The top section contains several animals, as well as looping and circular lines on the left and right sides, some forming chain-like or spiral shapes. The middle section features a higher concentration of animals and geometric elements in the center, including interconnected squares and lines, with a cross-mark and smaller animals dispersed nearby. The bottom section contains fewer animals, spaced wider apart, and in the bottom right corner, there is a figure composed of circular shapes and arcs stacked on top of each other, distinct from the animal forms. Overall, the color scheme is monochromatic, using only white for the illustrations and a dark blue-gray for the background.
title: Petroglyph
